names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 18 Ιουλίου, «Όσιος Βαρλαάμ ο αναχωρητής κοντά στην Αντιόχεια», with the rank word left off. The byname the page gives him is «ο αναχωρητής κοντά στην Αντιόχεια», the anchorite near Antioch; the first half of it is kept in the English display name.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its whole notice is one sentence: «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Οσίου» — we have no details of the life of this venerable one. He is not the corpus's `barlaam-of-antioch`, and the near miss wants saying: that folder's man is a martyr, kept by doxologia on 19 noiembrie, while this one is called Ὅσιος and an anchorite living near Antioch and is kept on 18 Ιουλίου — another rank, another day, another kind of life, and nothing on this page joins them. Nor is he any of the corpus's Russian and Moldavian Barlaams. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on this page; the day's «Άγιος Ιωάννης Θ' Πατριάρχης Κωνσταντινούπολης *» does carry it and is refused. The page gives no year and no account of anything, so there is no `dates` object; Antioch is named only in his byname, as the place his cell was near, so no `locations` is taken, and there is no hymn. The `types` are read from the two words the page does give, Ὅσιος and ἀναχωρητής.
